comments:
Block-print produced at Zhol par khang. 
One print is preserved at the national Library of Mongolia and was scanned by Asian Classics Input Project (see bdr:MW3CN14268). Another print (non-accessible), presumably from the same block-print in view of the number of folios, is listed in [8H6M69W4]: 1920, No. 22119.
